---
title: "Changelog"

Mistakes found in the course material and corrected, newest first.

If you read a chapter before the date of an entry, the version you read
said something wrong or imprecise on that point.

## 6 October 2026

[Chapter 05](chapters/05-docker.qmd), instruction table:

- Correction: `WORKDIR` is also the container's working directory, not
  only the build's.
- Correction: `COPY` takes files from the build context, not from
  anywhere on your machine.

[Code examples]({{< var examples-url >}}), `05-docker`:

- Correction: example 03, the override command used example 02's image
  name, and the `--entrypoint` line had one `/bin/bash` too many. Both
  failed.
- Correction: example 11, rewritten for two terminals, with a cleanup
  step.

## 5 October 2026

[Chapter 04](chapters/04-java-io.qmd):

- Correction: `read(byte[])` reads at least one byte, at most the array
  size. Only `-1` means the end.
- Correction: `readLine()` also ends a line on a lone `\r`.
- Correction: Java's `UTF-16` charset writes a BOM, so `é` takes 4
  bytes. `UTF-16BE` takes 2.
- Clarification: a code point is not always a character: 🇨🇭 is two.
- Clarification: buffer small reads and writes. Reading blocks needs no
  buffer.
- Clarification: charsets come from `java.nio.charset`.

[Chapters 00](chapters/00-environment-setup.qmd) to
[03](chapters/03-java-intellij-maven.qmd), and
[practical work 1](practical-work/pw1.qmd):

- Correction: JUnit 6.1.3, shade 3.6.2, jar 3.5.1. The example test now
  matches exercise 6.
- Correction: `wsl --install` needs Windows 10 version 2004, not 1607.
- Correction: your Git name and email are a label, not a signature.
- Clarification: a signature proves who made the commit, not who wrote
  the code.
- Clarification: the profile repository must be public.
- Clarification: `ssh -T git@github.com` answering "no shell access" is
  a success.
- Clarification: never commit what the build produces. Example files and
  the images of your README belong in the repository.
- Clarification: PW1, category 1 is 40% of the grade and tests are 4%.
